### u5-l3 SECONDFPN：从 3D 特征到多尺度 BEV 特征

SECONDFPN 是 SECOND backbone 与 Anchor3DHead 之间的 neck：把多尺度 BEV 特征对齐到同一分辨率后沿通道维 concat，输出单级大通道特征图（单元素列表），而非经典 FPN 的相加融合与多级输出。每条支路（deblock）=采样层+归一化+ReLU 三件套：stride>1 走 kernel=stride 的反卷积，实现整数倍无重叠上采样；stride<1（如 0.5）换算成普通卷积下采样，CenterPoint 以 upsample_strides=[0.5,1,2] 把汇聚点选在中间分辨率以省算力。norm_cfg 可配（默认 BN，可换 GN），激活函数硬编码为 ReLU 不可配置。两条硬契约：neck 输入通道逐元素等于 backbone 输出通道；head 的 in_channels 必须等于各支路 out_channels 之和。调用链上 VoxelNet.extract_feat 经 with_neck 调用 neck，其输出由 Anchor3DHead 按「多尺度特征列表」契约逐级消费，训练时按各级 featmap_sizes 生成 anchor 网格，衔接下一讲的 3D 锚框生成。
### u5-l4 Anchor3DHead 与 3D 锚框生成

本讲拆解 anchor-based 3D 检测头的三个核心模块（SECOND、PointPillars 等共用）。Anchor3DRangeGenerator 把 ranges（位置）、sizes（尺寸）、rotations（朝向）做笛卡尔积铺满 BEV 网格，anchor 总数＝H×W×尺寸数×朝向数（SECOND KITTI 下为 844800），anchor 的 z 语义是底面中心，Aligned 变体修复格点错位。DeltaXYZWLHRBBoxCoder 规定回归目标：z 先换几何中心再作差、位移按 BEV 对角线与高度归一、尺寸取 log 比，encode/decode 严格互逆，零差值解码回 anchor 自身。Anchor3DHead 仅含分类（A×C）、回归（A×7）、方向（A×2）三个 1×1 卷积分支；FocalLoss 走隐式背景并配 PseudoSampler，回归与方向损失只作用于正样本。角度两大难题分别由正弦差回归（消除 2π 周期）与方向二分类（解决 π 头尾歧义）化解，推理时经 limit_period 折叠加 dir_offset 修正拼回完整 yaw。
### u5-l5 CenterPoint：Anchor-free 的中心点范式

本讲剖析 CenterPoint 的 anchor-free 中心点范式：不预铺海量 anchor、不做 IoU 正负样本分配，而是让每个 BEV 格子预测自己是否为物体中心。CenterPoint 检测器是薄壳，复用 MVXTwoStageDetector 的柱体特征链路（PillarFeatureNet→Scatter→SECOND→SECONDFPN），仅把头换成 CenterHead；头按类别分成 6 个任务子头，每个子头内 SeparateHead 又分 heatmap/reg/height/dim/rot/vel 六个独立分支。训练目标由 get_targets 现场编码：gt 中心画高斯热图（半径随物体尺寸、重叠取 max），并生成 10 维回归目标（亚格子偏移、重心高度、log 尺寸、sin/cos 朝向、速度）；损失为 GaussianFocalLoss 加只在中心格计算的 L1，天然无需 assigner/sampler。推理由 CenterPointBBoxCoder 两级 topK 提取峰值、把格子坐标换算回米制、atan2 还原 yaw，再经 rotate 或 circle NMS 去重，合并六任务并把 z 从重心换回底面中心。
### u5-l6 任务模块：BBox Coder、3D Assigner 与 Sampler

本讲精读 `task_modules` 的训练目标生产线：IoU 计算器算重叠 → Assigner 定身份 → Sampler 挑下标 → BBox Coder 编码回归目标。这些组件无参数、注册于 `TASK_UTILS`，标准调用现场是 `train_mixins` 的 `anchor_target_single_assigner`，返回与 anchor 等长的打表式 8 元组目标。核心结论：`Max3DIoUAssigner` 只重写准备阶段，四步准则继承自 mmdet——IoU 达 `pos_iou_thr` 为正、全部低于 `neg_iou_thr` 为负、其间是忽略带，第 4 步低质量匹配受 `min_pos_iou` 约束保证每个 gt 有正样本；`AssignResult.gt_inds` 以 0 为负、正整数 k 指向第 k−1 个 gt、−1 为忽略；`SamplingResult` 由 pos_inds/neg_inds 派生 pos_gt_bboxes 等（查 gt 需减一）。两种编码哲学对比：`DeltaXYZWLHRBBoxCoder` 回归相对 anchor 的连续偏移并显式换算底面/几何中心；`PartialBinBasedBBoxCoder`（VoteNet 系）把尺寸、朝向拆成 bin 分类加残差，中心取 gravity_center 且 decode 不修正，往返误差恰为 z 列 h/2。FocalLoss 配不采样的 PseudoSampler，`IoUNegPiecewiseSampler` 供两阶段按 IoU 分段抽负样本；VoteNet 以 chamfer 距离匹配替代 assigner。
### u5-l7 3D 损失函数与 NMS

本讲讲解 mmdet3d 三个原生损失与五种 3D 去重后处理。损失均为「无参 nn.Module 壳 + weighted_loss 装饰的裸函数」双层结构，加权与规约由装饰器统一处理，且都属于配对后的对齐 IoU 计算。RotatedIoU3DLoss 处理 7 维旋转框，依赖 mmcv 的 CUDA 可微算子，仅 GPU 可用；AxisAlignedIoULoss 面向室内 6 维对角点框，纯 PyTorch 实现并支持 GIoU 模式；MultiBinLoss 以「bin 分类 + sin/cos 残差回归」化解角度周期性，源码因 return 缩进在循环内而实际只累计第一个 bin。去重方面：box3d_multiclass_nms 逐类调度，按 use_rotate_nms 分派旋转的 nms_bev 与轴对齐的 nms_normal_bev（承接 0.x 旧接口）；aligned_3d_nms 为类别感知的室内体积 NMS；circle_nms 用中心平方距离替代 IoU，阈值需按平方理解。选型直觉：anchor 系用旋转 BEV NMS，室内点云用轴对齐 NMS，CenterPoint 等中心点范式偏爱 circle NMS。
### u6-l1 PointNet++ 系列骨干网络

本讲梳理 PointNet++ 系列点路线骨干：与体素路线（单元 5）相对，不栅格化点云，感受野由米制 radius 显式给出。核心是 SA 模块（Set Abstraction，集合抽象）的采样—分组—聚合三步：FPS 选中心、球查询取邻域、共享 MLP 加邻居维池化，集合运算统一伪装成 (1,1) Conv2d。BasePointNet 固化 (B,N,3+C) 输入契约，特征切分为 (B,C,N) 布局。PointNet2SASSG 是 SA 下采样塔加 FP 上采样（3 近邻距离倒数加权插值）的 U 形骨干，VoteNet 取其末级 1024 个 seed 点供投票；PointNet2SAMSG 无 FP 塔，用多尺度分组、D-FPS/F-FPS/FS 采样、膨胀球壳与聚合压缩，服务 3DSSD/PointRCNN。另介绍变长堆叠、中心点外部给定的 StackedSAModuleMSG（PV-RCNN 关键点分支）与 PointNetFPNeck。骨干输出 dict 而非列表，各级通道可由 skip_channel_list 纸面推导。
### u6-l2 VoteNet：基于投票的室内检测端到端解析

本讲端到端解析室内点云检测器 VoteNet。核心思想是投票（vote）：室内物体只有表面点、几何中心悬空，故让每个表面点（object coordinate）回归指向物体中心（center coordinate）的偏移，票在中心聚簇后再分类回归，且全程采用几何中心口径。前向链路四步：VoteModule 由种子点生成投票点与残差特征；PointSAModule 聚合成提案（训练在投票点上采样、测试在种子点上采样）；BaseConvBboxHead 打分；PartialBinBasedBBoxCoder 解码。VoteNet 无 anchor 与 assigner，提案与真值靠 Chamfer 最近邻匹配，距离小于 0.3 为正、大于 0.6 为负、中间忽略带不计损失；共八项损失，center 损失为双向 Chamfer。推理依次做空框过滤（框内点数大于 5）、aligned_3d_nms 与 per_class_proposal（分数为 objectness 乘语义概率）。检测器为薄壳，重写 loss/predict 仅为把原始点云传入 VoteHead 以生成投票监督。
### u6-l3 更多点云检测器：GroupFree3D、3DSSD、H3DNet

本讲对比三个 VoteNet 之后的进阶点云检测器。GroupFree3D 用 kps 前景打分选候选点，经多层 Transformer 解码器迭代精修出框，取代「投票+分组」范式，逐层深监督。3DSSD 用 F-FPS 特征距离采样保证前景覆盖，投票降为辅助分支，新增 centerness（连续中心度）、corner loss、vote loss 三项监督，推理时 objectness 直接取语义分最大值。H3DNet 为两阶段结构：VoteNet 当 RPN 产提案，RoI 阶段用 z 面、xy 面、line 边三类几何基元匹配提案的 6 面心与 12 边心做残差精修。核心结论：室内检测器不用 IoU assigner，正负样本按「点在框内」或 Chamfer 距离分配；三者共享薄壳检测器加厚 head、gravity_center 口径与 bin-based 编码模板。
### u6-l4 两阶段检测器与 RoI Heads：Part-A2 与 PV-RCNN

本讲剖析两阶段 3D 检测框架：TwoStage3DDetector 把「RPN 出提案、RoI head 精修」串成完整训练与推理链路，train_cfg 按 rpn、rpn_proposal、rcnn 三段注入各组件；roi_heads 子系统由基类骨架、roi_extractors 特征提取器与 bbox_heads 回归头三层组成。Part-A2 用逐体素语义头做前景分割与部位回归，part_feats 经 feats_dict 耦合进 RoI 分支，RoIAwarePool3d 把 RoI 内点重栅格化为 14³ 网格（point→voxel），再由稀疏卷积 bbox head 精修，训练目标为 IoU 软标签、canonical 变换编码与 corner loss 三件套。PV-RCNN 的 VoxelSetAbstraction 以 FPS 关键点做三源特征融合，Batch3DRoIGridExtractor 用 6³ 网格点球查询聚合 RoI 特征。核心结论：Part-A2 池化 RoI 内部的点，PV-RCNN 池化全局关键点，这是二者 RoI 特征来源的本质差异。

from typing import Tuple

from mmdet.models.detectors.single_stage import SingleStageDetector
from mmengine.structures import InstanceData
from torch import Tensor

from mmdet3d.registry import MODELS
from mmdet3d.structures.det3d_data_sample import SampleList
from mmdet3d.utils import OptInstanceList


@MODELS.register_module()
class SingleStageMono3DDetector(SingleStageDetector):
    """Base class for monocular 3D single-stage detectors.

    Monocular 3D single-stage detectors directly and densely predict bounding
    boxes on the output features of the backbone+neck.
    """

    def add_pred_to_datasample(
        self,
        data_samples: SampleList,
        data_instances_3d: OptInstanceList = None,
        data_instances_2d: OptInstanceList = None,
    ) -> SampleList:
        """Convert results list to `Det3DDataSample`.

        Args:
            data_samples (list[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]): The input data.
            data_instances_3d (list[:obj:`InstanceData`], optional): 3D
                Detection results of each image. Defaults to None.
            data_instances_2d (list[:obj:`InstanceData`], optional): 2D
                Detection results of each image. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            list[:obj:`Det3DDataSample`]: Detection results of the
            input. Each Det3DDataSample usually contains
            'pred_instances_3d'. And the ``pred_instances_3d`` normally
            contains following keys.

            - scores_3d (Tensor): Classification scores, has a shape
              (num_instance, )
            - labels_3d (Tensor): Labels of 3D bboxes, has a shape
              (num_instances, ).
            - bboxes_3d (Tensor): Contains a tensor with shape
              (num_instances, C) where C >=7.

            When there are 2D prediction in some models, it should
            contains  `pred_instances`, And the ``pred_instances`` normally
            contains following keys.

            - scores (Tensor): Classification scores of image, has a shape
              (num_instance, )
            - labels (Tensor): Predict Labels of 2D bboxes, has a shape
              (num_instances, ).
            - bboxes (Tensor): Contains a tensor with shape
              (num_instances, 4).
        """

        assert (data_instances_2d is not None) or \
               (data_instances_3d is not None),\
               'please pass at least one type of data_samples'

        if data_instances_2d is None:
            data_instances_2d = [
                InstanceData() for _ in range(len(data_instances_3d))
            ]
        if data_instances_3d is None:
            data_instances_3d = [
                InstanceData() for _ in range(len(data_instances_2d))
            ]

        for i, data_sample in enumerate(data_samples):
            data_sample.pred_instances_3d = data_instances_3d[i]
            data_sample.pred_instances = data_instances_2d[i]
        return data_samples

    def extract_feat(self, batch_inputs_dict: dict) -> Tuple[Tensor]:
        """Extract features.

        Args:
            batch_inputs_dict (dict): Contains 'img' key
                with image tensor with shape (N, C, H ,W).

        Returns:
            tuple[Tensor]: Multi-level features that may have
            different resolutions.
        """
        batch_imgs = batch_inputs_dict['imgs']
        x = self.backbone(batch_imgs)
        if self.with_neck:
            x = self.neck(x)
        return x

    # TODO: Support test time augmentation
    def aug_test(self, imgs, img_metas, rescale=False):
        """Test function with test time augmentation."""

118	            conv_channels=self.centerness_branch,
119	            conv_strides=(1, ) * len(self.centerness_branch))

130	        We currently still use the customized init_weights because the default
131	        init of DCN triggered by the init_cfg will init conv_offset.weight,
132	        which mistakenly affects the training stability.

140	    def forward(
141	        self, x: Tuple[Tensor]
142	    ) -> Tuple[List[Tensor], List[Tensor], List[Tensor], List[Tensor],
143	               List[Tensor]]:
144	        """Forward features from the upstream network.
145	
146	        Args:
147	            x (tuple[Tensor]): Features from the upstream network, each is
148	                a 4D-tensor.
149	
150	        Returns:
151	            tuple:
152	                cls_scores (list[Tensor]): Box scores for each scale level,
153	                    each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is
154	                    num_points * num_classes.
155	                bbox_preds (list[Tensor]): Box energies / deltas for each scale
156	                    level, each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is
157	                    num_points * bbox_code_size.
158	                dir_cls_preds (list[Tensor]): Box scores for direction class
159	                    predictions on each scale level, each is a 4D-tensor,
160	                    the channel number is num_points * 2. (bin = 2).
161	                attr_preds (list[Tensor]): Attribute scores for each scale
162	                    level, each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is

165	                    each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is num_points * 1.

171	    def forward_single(self, x: Tensor, scale: Scale,
172	                       stride: int) -> Tuple[Tensor, ...]:
173	        """Forward features of a single scale level.
174	
175	        Args:
176	            x (Tensor): FPN feature maps of the specified stride.
177	            scale (:obj: `mmcv.cnn.Scale`): Learnable scale module to resize
178	                the bbox prediction.
179	            stride (int): The corresponding stride for feature maps, only
180	                used to normalize the bbox prediction when self.norm_on_bbox
181	                is True.

183	        Returns:

185	                predictions, centerness predictions of input feature maps.
186	        """
187	        cls_score, bbox_pred, dir_cls_pred, attr_pred, cls_feat, reg_feat = \
188	            super().forward_single(x)
189	
190	        if self.centerness_on_reg:
191	            clone_reg_feat = reg_feat.clone()
192	            for conv_centerness_prev_layer in self.conv_centerness_prev:
193	                clone_reg_feat = conv_centerness_prev_layer(clone_reg_feat)
194	            centerness = self.conv_centerness(clone_reg_feat)
195	        else:
196	            clone_cls_feat = cls_feat.clone()
197	            for conv_centerness_prev_layer in self.conv_centerness_prev:
198	                clone_cls_feat = conv_centerness_prev_layer(clone_cls_feat)
199	            centerness = self.conv_centerness(clone_cls_feat)
200	
201	        bbox_pred = self.bbox_coder.decode(bbox_pred, scale, stride,

204	        return cls_score, bbox_pred, dir_cls_pred, attr_pred, centerness, \

207	    @staticmethod
208	    def add_sin_difference(boxes1: Tensor,
209	                           boxes2: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
210	        """Convert the rotation difference to difference in sine function.
211	
212	        Args:
213	            boxes1 (torch.Tensor): Original Boxes in shape (NxC), where C>=7
214	                and the 7th dimension is rotation dimension.
215	            boxes2 (torch.Tensor): Target boxes in shape (NxC), where C>=7 and
216	                the 7th dimension is rotation dimension.
217	
218	        Returns:
219	            tuple[torch.Tensor]: ``boxes1`` and ``boxes2`` whose 7th
220	                dimensions are changed.
221	        """
222	        rad_pred_encoding = torch.sin(boxes1[..., 6:7]) * torch.cos(
223	            boxes2[..., 6:7])
224	        rad_tg_encoding = torch.cos(boxes1[..., 6:7]) * torch.sin(boxes2[...,
225	                                                                         6:7])
226	        boxes1 = torch.cat(
227	            [boxes1[..., :6], rad_pred_encoding, boxes1[..., 7:]], dim=-1)
228	        boxes2 = torch.cat([boxes2[..., :6], rad_tg_encoding, boxes2[..., 7:]],
229	                           dim=-1)
230	        return boxes1, boxes2
231	
232	    @staticmethod
233	    def get_direction_target(reg_targets: Tensor,
234	                             dir_offset: int = 0,
235	                             dir_limit_offset: float = 0.0,
236	                             num_bins: int = 2,
237	                             one_hot: bool = True) -> Tensor:
238	        """Encode direction to 0 ~ num_bins-1.
239	
240	        Args:
241	            reg_targets (torch.Tensor): Bbox regression targets.
242	            dir_offset (int, optional): Direction offset. Default to 0.
243	            dir_limit_offset (float, optional): Offset to set the direction
244	                range. Default to 0.0.
245	            num_bins (int, optional): Number of bins to divide 2*PI.
246	                Default to 2.
247	            one_hot (bool, optional): Whether to encode as one hot.
248	                Default to True.
249	
250	        Returns:
251	            torch.Tensor: Encoded direction targets.
252	        """
253	        rot_gt = reg_targets[..., 6]
254	        offset_rot = limit_period(rot_gt - dir_offset, dir_limit_offset,
255	                                  2 * np.pi)
256	        dir_cls_targets = torch.floor(offset_rot /
257	                                      (2 * np.pi / num_bins)).long()
258	        dir_cls_targets = torch.clamp(dir_cls_targets, min=0, max=num_bins - 1)
259	        if one_hot:
260	            dir_targets = torch.zeros(
261	                *list(dir_cls_targets.shape),
262	                num_bins,
263	                dtype=reg_targets.dtype,
264	                device=dir_cls_targets.device)
265	            dir_targets.scatter_(dir_cls_targets.unsqueeze(dim=-1).long(), 1.0)
266	            dir_cls_targets = dir_targets
267	        return dir_cls_targets

269	    def loss_by_feat(
270	            self,
271	            cls_scores: List[Tensor],
272	            bbox_preds: List[Tensor],
273	            dir_cls_preds: List[Tensor],
274	            attr_preds: List[Tensor],
275	            centernesses: List[Tensor],
276	            batch_gt_instances_3d: InstanceList,
277	            batch_gt_instacnes: InstanceList,
278	            batch_img_metas: List[dict],
279	            batch_gt_instances_ignore: OptInstanceList = None) -> dict:
280	        """Compute loss of the head.
281	
282	        Args:
283	            cls_scores (list[Tensor]): Box scores for each scale level,
284	                each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is
285	                num_points * num_classes.
286	            bbox_preds (list[Tensor]): Box energies / deltas for each scale
287	                level, each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is
288	                num_points * bbox_code_size.
289	            dir_cls_preds (list[Tensor]): Box scores for direction class
290	                predictions on each scale level, each is a 4D-tensor,
291	                the channel number is num_points * 2. (bin = 2)
292	            attr_preds (list[Tensor]): Attribute scores for each scale level,
293	                each is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is
294	                num_points * num_attrs.
295	            centernesses (list[Tensor]): Centerness for each scale level, each
296	                is a 4D-tensor, the channel number is num_points * 1.
297	            batch_gt_instances_3d (list[:obj:`InstanceData`]): Batch of
298	                gt_instance_3d.  It usually includes ``bboxes_3d``、`
299	                `labels_3d``、``depths``、``centers_2d`` and attributes.
300	            batch_gt_instances (list[:obj:`InstanceData`]): Batch of
301	                gt_instance.  It usually includes ``bboxes``、``labels``.
302	            batch_img_metas (list[dict]): Meta information of each image, e.g.,
303	                image size, scaling factor, etc.
304	            batch_gt_instances_ignore (list[:obj:`InstanceData`], Optional):
305	                Batch of gt_instances_ignore. It includes ``bboxes`` attribute
306	                data that is ignored during training and testing.
307	                Defaults to None.
308	
309	        Returns:
310	            dict[str, Tensor]: A dictionary of loss components.
311	        """
312	        assert len(cls_scores) == len(bbox_preds) == len(centernesses) == len(
313	            attr_preds)
314	        featmap_sizes = [featmap.size()[-2:] for featmap in cls_scores]
315	        all_level_points = self.get_points(featmap_sizes, bbox_preds[0].dtype,
316	                                           bbox_preds[0].device)
317	        labels_3d, bbox_targets_3d, centerness_targets, attr_targets = \
318	            self.get_targets(all_level_points, batch_gt_instances_3d,
319	                             batch_gt_instacnes)
320	
321	        num_imgs = cls_scores[0].size(0)
322	        # flatten cls_scores, bbox_preds, dir_cls_preds and centerness
323	        flatten_cls_scores = [
324	            cls_score.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(-1, self.cls_out_channels)
325	            for cls_score in cls_scores
326	        ]
327	        flatten_bbox_preds = [
328	            bbox_pred.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(-1, sum(self.group_reg_dims))
329	            for bbox_pred in bbox_preds
330	        ]
331	        flatten_dir_cls_preds = [
332	            dir_cls_pred.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(-1, 2)
333	            for dir_cls_pred in dir_cls_preds
334	        ]
335	        flatten_centerness = [
336	            centerness.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(-1)
337	            for centerness in centernesses
338	        ]
339	        flatten_cls_scores = torch.cat(flatten_cls_scores)
340	        flatten_bbox_preds = torch.cat(flatten_bbox_preds)
341	        flatten_dir_cls_preds = torch.cat(flatten_dir_cls_preds)
342	        flatten_centerness = torch.cat(flatten_centerness)
343	        flatten_labels_3d = torch.cat(labels_3d)
344	        flatten_bbox_targets_3d = torch.cat(bbox_targets_3d)
345	        flatten_centerness_targets = torch.cat(centerness_targets)
346	
347	        # FG cat_id: [0, num_classes -1], BG cat_id: num_classes
348	        bg_class_ind = self.num_classes
349	        pos_inds = ((flatten_labels_3d >= 0)
350	                    & (flatten_labels_3d < bg_class_ind)).nonzero().reshape(-1)
351	        num_pos = len(pos_inds)
352	
353	        loss_cls = self.loss_cls(
354	            flatten_cls_scores,
355	            flatten_labels_3d,
356	            avg_factor=num_pos + num_imgs)  # avoid num_pos is 0
357	
358	        pos_bbox_preds = flatten_bbox_preds[pos_inds]
359	        pos_dir_cls_preds = flatten_dir_cls_preds[pos_inds]
360	        pos_centerness = flatten_centerness[pos_inds]
361	
362	        if self.pred_attrs:
363	            flatten_attr_preds = [
364	                attr_pred.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(-1, self.num_attrs)
365	                for attr_pred in attr_preds
366	            ]
367	            flatten_attr_preds = torch.cat(flatten_attr_preds)
368	            flatten_attr_targets = torch.cat(attr_targets)
369	            pos_attr_preds = flatten_attr_preds[pos_inds]
370	
371	        if num_pos > 0:
372	            pos_bbox_targets_3d = flatten_bbox_targets_3d[pos_inds]
373	            pos_centerness_targets = flatten_centerness_targets[pos_inds]
374	            if self.pred_attrs:
375	                pos_attr_targets = flatten_attr_targets[pos_inds]
376	            bbox_weights = pos_centerness_targets.new_ones(
377	                len(pos_centerness_targets), sum(self.group_reg_dims))
378	            equal_weights = pos_centerness_targets.new_ones(
379	                pos_centerness_targets.shape)
380	
381	            code_weight = self.train_cfg.get('code_weight', None)
382	            if code_weight:
383	                assert len(code_weight) == sum(self.group_reg_dims)
384	                bbox_weights = bbox_weights * bbox_weights.new_tensor(
385	                    code_weight)
386	
387	            if self.use_direction_classifier:
388	                pos_dir_cls_targets = self.get_direction_target(
389	                    pos_bbox_targets_3d,
390	                    self.dir_offset,
391	                    self.dir_limit_offset,
392	                    one_hot=False)
393	
394	            if self.diff_rad_by_sin:
395	                pos_bbox_preds, pos_bbox_targets_3d = self.add_sin_difference(
396	                    pos_bbox_preds, pos_bbox_targets_3d)
397	
398	            loss_offset = self.loss_bbox(
399	                pos_bbox_preds[:, :2],
400	                pos_bbox_targets_3d[:, :2],
401	                weight=bbox_weights[:, :2],
402	                avg_factor=equal_weights.sum())
403	            loss_depth = self.loss_bbox(
404	                pos_bbox_preds[:, 2],
405	                pos_bbox_targets_3d[:, 2],
406	                weight=bbox_weights[:, 2],
407	                avg_factor=equal_weights.sum())
408	            loss_size = self.loss_bbox(
409	                pos_bbox_preds[:, 3:6],
410	                pos_bbox_targets_3d[:, 3:6],
411	                weight=bbox_weights[:, 3:6],
412	                avg_factor=equal_weights.sum())
413	            loss_rotsin = self.loss_bbox(
414	                pos_bbox_preds[:, 6],
415	                pos_bbox_targets_3d[:, 6],
416	                weight=bbox_weights[:, 6],
417	                avg_factor=equal_weights.sum())
418	            loss_velo = None
419	            if self.pred_velo:
420	                loss_velo = self.loss_bbox(
421	                    pos_bbox_preds[:, 7:9],
422	                    pos_bbox_targets_3d[:, 7:9],
423	                    weight=bbox_weights[:, 7:9],
424	                    avg_factor=equal_weights.sum())
425	
426	            loss_centerness = self.loss_centerness(pos_centerness,
427	                                                   pos_centerness_targets)
428	
429	            # direction classification loss
430	            loss_dir = None
431	            # TODO: add more check for use_direction_classifier
432	            if self.use_direction_classifier:
433	                loss_dir = self.loss_dir(
434	                    pos_dir_cls_preds,
435	                    pos_dir_cls_targets,
436	                    equal_weights,
437	                    avg_factor=equal_weights.sum())
438	
439	            # attribute classification loss
440	            loss_attr = None
441	            if self.pred_attrs:
442	                loss_attr = self.loss_attr(
443	                    pos_attr_preds,
444	                    pos_attr_targets,
445	                    pos_centerness_targets,
446	                    avg_factor=pos_centerness_targets.sum())
447	
448	        else:
449	            # need absolute due to possible negative delta x/y
450	            loss_offset = pos_bbox_preds[:, :2].sum()
451	            loss_depth = pos_bbox_preds[:, 2].sum()
452	            loss_size = pos_bbox_preds[:, 3:6].sum()
453	            loss_rotsin = pos_bbox_preds[:, 6].sum()
454	            loss_velo = None
455	            if self.pred_velo:
456	                loss_velo = pos_bbox_preds[:, 7:9].sum()
457	            loss_centerness = pos_centerness.sum()
458	            loss_dir = None
459	            if self.use_direction_classifier:
460	                loss_dir = pos_dir_cls_preds.sum()
461	            loss_attr = None
462	            if self.pred_attrs:
463	                loss_attr = pos_attr_preds.sum()
464	
465	        loss_dict = dict(
466	            loss_cls=loss_cls,
467	            loss_offset=loss_offset,
468	            loss_depth=loss_depth,
469	            loss_size=loss_size,
470	            loss_rotsin=loss_rotsin,
471	            loss_centerness=loss_centerness)
472	
473	        if loss_velo is not None:
474	            loss_dict['loss_velo'] = loss_velo
475	
476	        if loss_dir is not None:
477	            loss_dict['loss_dir'] = loss_dir
478	
479	        if loss_attr is not None:
480	            loss_dict['loss_attr'] = loss_attr
481	
482	        return loss_dict

484	    def predict_by_feat(self,
485	                        cls_scores: List[Tensor],
486	                        bbox_preds: List[Tensor],
487	                        dir_cls_preds: List[Tensor],
488	                        attr_preds: List[Tensor],
489	                        centernesses: List[Tensor],
490	                        batch_img_metas: Optional[List[dict]] = None,
491	                        cfg: OptConfigType = None,
492	                        rescale: bool = False) -> InstanceList:
493	        """Transform network output for a batch into bbox predictions.
494	
495	        Args:
496	            cls_scores (list[Tensor]): Box scores for each scale level
497	                Has shape (N, num_points * num_classes, H, W)
498	            bbox_preds (list[Tensor]): Box energies / deltas for each scale
499	                level with shape (N, num_points * 4, H, W)
500	            dir_cls_preds (list[Tensor]): Box scores for direction class
501	                predictions on each scale level, each is a 4D-tensor,
502	                the channel number is num_points * 2. (bin = 2)
503	            attr_preds (list[Tensor]): Attribute scores for each scale level
504	                Has shape (N, num_points * num_attrs, H, W)
505	            centernesses (list[Tensor]): Centerness for each scale level with
506	                shape (N, num_points * 1, H, W)
507	            batch_img_metas (list[dict]): Meta information of each image, e.g.,
508	                image size, scaling factor, etc.
509	            cfg (ConfigDict, optional): Test / postprocessing
510	                configuration, if None, test_cfg would be used.
511	                Defaults to None.
512	            rescale (bool): If True, return boxes in original image space.
513	                Defaults to False.
514	
515	        Returns:
516	            list[:obj:`InstanceData`]: Object detection results of each image
517	            after the post process. Each item usually contains following keys.
518	
519	                - scores_3d (Tensor): Classification scores, has a shape
520	                  (num_instance, )
521	                - labels_3d (Tensor): Labels of bboxes, has a shape
522	                  (num_instances, ).
523	                - bboxes_3d (Tensor): Contains a tensor with shape
524	                  (num_instances, C), where C >= 7.
525	        """
526	        assert len(cls_scores) == len(bbox_preds) == len(dir_cls_preds) == \
527	            len(centernesses) == len(attr_preds)
528	        num_levels = len(cls_scores)
529	
530	        featmap_sizes = [featmap.size()[-2:] for featmap in cls_scores]
531	        # TODO: refactor using prior_generator
532	        mlvl_points = self.get_points(featmap_sizes, bbox_preds[0].dtype,
533	                                      bbox_preds[0].device)
534	        result_list = []
535	        for img_id in range(len(batch_img_metas)):
536	            img_meta = batch_img_metas[img_id]
537	            cls_score_list = select_single_mlvl(cls_scores, img_id)
538	            bbox_pred_list = select_single_mlvl(bbox_preds, img_id)
539	
540	            if self.use_direction_classifier:
541	                dir_cls_pred_list = select_single_mlvl(dir_cls_preds, img_id)
542	            else:
543	                dir_cls_pred_list = [
544	                    cls_scores[i][img_id].new_full(
545	                        [2, *cls_scores[i][img_id].shape[1:]], 0).detach()
546	                    for i in range(num_levels)
547	                ]
548	
549	            if self.pred_attrs:
550	                attr_pred_list = select_single_mlvl(attr_preds, img_id)
551	            else:
552	                attr_pred_list = [
553	                    cls_scores[i][img_id].new_full(
554	                        [self.num_attrs, *cls_scores[i][img_id].shape[1:]],
555	                        self.attr_background_label).detach()
556	                    for i in range(num_levels)
557	                ]
558	
559	            centerness_pred_list = select_single_mlvl(centernesses, img_id)
560	            results = self._predict_by_feat_single(
561	                cls_score_list=cls_score_list,
562	                bbox_pred_list=bbox_pred_list,
563	                dir_cls_pred_list=dir_cls_pred_list,
564	                attr_pred_list=attr_pred_list,
565	                centerness_pred_list=centerness_pred_list,
566	                mlvl_points=mlvl_points,
567	                img_meta=img_meta,
568	                cfg=cfg,
569	                rescale=rescale)
570	            result_list.append(results)
571	        result_list_2d = None
572	        return result_list, result_list_2d
573	
574	    def _predict_by_feat_single(self,
575	                                cls_score_list: List[Tensor],
576	                                bbox_pred_list: List[Tensor],
577	                                dir_cls_pred_list: List[Tensor],
578	                                attr_pred_list: List[Tensor],
579	                                centerness_pred_list: List[Tensor],
580	                                mlvl_points: Tensor,
581	                                img_meta: dict,
582	                                cfg: ConfigType,
583	                                rescale: bool = False) -> InstanceData:
584	        """Transform outputs for a single batch item into bbox predictions.
585	
586	        Args:
587	            cls_scores (list[Tensor]): Box scores for a single scale level
588	                Has shape (num_points * num_classes, H, W).
589	            bbox_preds (list[Tensor]): Box energies / deltas for a single scale
590	                level with shape (num_points * bbox_code_size, H, W).
591	            dir_cls_preds (list[Tensor]): Box scores for direction class
592	                predictions on a single scale level with shape
593	                (num_points * 2, H, W)
594	            attr_preds (list[Tensor]): Attribute scores for each scale level
595	                Has shape (N, num_points * num_attrs, H, W)
596	            centernesses (list[Tensor]): Centerness for a single scale level
597	                with shape (num_points, H, W).
598	            mlvl_points (list[Tensor]): Box reference for a single scale level
599	                with shape (num_total_points, 2).
600	            img_meta (dict): Metadata of input image.
601	            cfg (mmengine.Config): Test / postprocessing configuration,
602	                if None, test_cfg would be used.
603	            rescale (bool): If True, return boxes in original image space.
604	
605	        Returns:
606	            :obj:`InstanceData`: 3D Detection results of each image
607	            after the post process.
608	            Each item usually contains following keys.
609	
610	                - scores_3d (Tensor): Classification scores, has a shape
611	                  (num_instance, )
612	                - labels_3d (Tensor): Labels of bboxes, has a shape
613	                  (num_instances, ).
614	                - bboxes_3d (Tensor): Contains a tensor with shape
615	                  (num_instances, C), where C >= 7.
616	        """
617	        view = np.array(img_meta['cam2img'])
618	        scale_factor = img_meta['scale_factor']
619	        cfg = self.test_cfg if cfg is None else cfg
620	        assert len(cls_score_list) == len(bbox_pred_list) == len(mlvl_points)
621	        mlvl_centers_2d = []
622	        mlvl_bboxes = []
623	        mlvl_scores = []
624	        mlvl_dir_scores = []
625	        mlvl_attr_scores = []
626	        mlvl_centerness = []
627	
628	        for cls_score, bbox_pred, dir_cls_pred, attr_pred, centerness, \
629	                points in zip(cls_score_list, bbox_pred_list,
630	                              dir_cls_pred_list, attr_pred_list,
631	                              centerness_pred_list, mlvl_points):
632	            assert cls_score.size()[-2:] == bbox_pred.size()[-2:]
633	            scores = cls_score.permute(1, 2, 0).reshape(
634	                -1, self.cls_out_channels).sigmoid()
635	            dir_cls_pred = dir_cls_pred.permute(1, 2, 0).reshape(-1, 2)
636	            dir_cls_score = torch.max(dir_cls_pred, dim=-1)[1]
637	            attr_pred = attr_pred.permute(1, 2, 0).reshape(-1, self.num_attrs)
638	            attr_score = torch.max(attr_pred, dim=-1)[1]
639	            centerness = centerness.permute(1, 2, 0).reshape(-1).sigmoid()
640	
641	            bbox_pred = bbox_pred.permute(1, 2,
642	                                          0).reshape(-1,
643	                                                     sum(self.group_reg_dims))
644	            bbox_pred = bbox_pred[:, :self.bbox_code_size]
645	            nms_pre = cfg.get('nms_pre', -1)
646	            if nms_pre > 0 and scores.shape[0] > nms_pre:
647	                max_scores, _ = (scores * centerness[:, None]).max(dim=1)
648	                _, topk_inds = max_scores.topk(nms_pre)
649	                points = points[topk_inds, :]
650	                bbox_pred = bbox_pred[topk_inds, :]
651	                scores = scores[topk_inds, :]
652	                dir_cls_pred = dir_cls_pred[topk_inds, :]
653	                centerness = centerness[topk_inds]
654	                dir_cls_score = dir_cls_score[topk_inds]
655	                attr_score = attr_score[topk_inds]
656	            # change the offset to actual center predictions
657	            bbox_pred[:, :2] = points - bbox_pred[:, :2]
658	            if rescale:
659	                bbox_pred[:, :2] /= bbox_pred[:, :2].new_tensor(scale_factor)
660	            pred_center2d = bbox_pred[:, :3].clone()
661	            bbox_pred[:, :3] = points_img2cam(bbox_pred[:, :3], view)
662	            mlvl_centers_2d.append(pred_center2d)
663	            mlvl_bboxes.append(bbox_pred)
664	            mlvl_scores.append(scores)
665	            mlvl_dir_scores.append(dir_cls_score)
666	            mlvl_attr_scores.append(attr_score)
667	            mlvl_centerness.append(centerness)
668	
669	        mlvl_centers_2d = torch.cat(mlvl_centers_2d)
670	        mlvl_bboxes = torch.cat(mlvl_bboxes)
671	        mlvl_dir_scores = torch.cat(mlvl_dir_scores)
672	
673	        # change local yaw to global yaw for 3D nms
674	        cam2img = mlvl_centers_2d.new_zeros((4, 4))
675	        cam2img[:view.shape[0], :view.shape[1]] = \
676	            mlvl_centers_2d.new_tensor(view)
677	        mlvl_bboxes = self.bbox_coder.decode_yaw(mlvl_bboxes, mlvl_centers_2d,
678	                                                 mlvl_dir_scores,
679	                                                 self.dir_offset, cam2img)
680	
681	        mlvl_bboxes_for_nms = xywhr2xyxyr(img_meta['box_type_3d'](
682	            mlvl_bboxes, box_dim=self.bbox_code_size,
683	            origin=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)).bev)
684	
685	        mlvl_scores = torch.cat(mlvl_scores)
686	        padding = mlvl_scores.new_zeros(mlvl_scores.shape[0], 1)
687	        # remind that we set FG labels to [0, num_class-1] since mmdet v2.0
688	        # BG cat_id: num_class
689	        mlvl_scores = torch.cat([mlvl_scores, padding], dim=1)
690	        mlvl_attr_scores = torch.cat(mlvl_attr_scores)
691	        mlvl_centerness = torch.cat(mlvl_centerness)
692	        # no scale_factors in box3d_multiclass_nms
693	        # Then we multiply it from outside
694	        mlvl_nms_scores = mlvl_scores * mlvl_centerness[:, None]
695	        results = box3d_multiclass_nms(mlvl_bboxes, mlvl_bboxes_for_nms,
696	                                       mlvl_nms_scores, cfg.score_thr,
697	                                       cfg.max_per_img, cfg, mlvl_dir_scores,
698	                                       mlvl_attr_scores)
699	        bboxes, scores, labels, dir_scores, attrs = results
700	        attrs = attrs.to(labels.dtype)  # change data type to int
701	        bboxes = img_meta['box_type_3d'](
702	            bboxes, box_dim=self.bbox_code_size, origin=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
703	        # Note that the predictions use origin (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
704	        # Due to the ground truth centers_2d are the gravity center of objects
705	        # v0.10.0 fix inplace operation to the input tensor of cam_box3d
706	        # So here we also need to add origin=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
707	
708	        results = InstanceData()
709	        results.bboxes_3d = bboxes
710	        results.scores_3d = scores
711	        results.labels_3d = labels
712	        if self.pred_attrs and attrs is not None:
713	            results.attr_labels = attrs
714	
715	        return results
716	
717	    def _get_points_single(self,
718	                           featmap_size: Tuple[int],
719	                           stride: int,
720	                           dtype: torch.dtype,
721	                           device: torch.device,
722	                           flatten: bool = False) -> Tensor:
723	        """Get points of a single scale level.
724	
725	        Args:
726	            featmap_size (tuple[int]): Single scale level feature map size.
727	            stride (int): Downsample factor of the feature map.
728	            dtype (torch.dtype): Type of points.
729	            device (torch.device): Device of points.
730	            flatten (bool): Whether to flatten the tensor.
731	                Defaults to False.
732	
733	        Returns:
734	            Tensor: points of each image.
735	        """
736	        y, x = super()._get_points_single(featmap_size, stride, dtype, device)
737	        points = torch.stack((x.reshape(-1) * stride, y.reshape(-1) * stride),
738	                             dim=-1) + stride // 2
739	        return points

741	    def get_targets(
742	        self,
743	        points: List[Tensor],
744	        batch_gt_instances_3d: InstanceList,
745	        batch_gt_instances: InstanceList,
746	    ) -> Tuple[List[Tensor], List[Tensor], List[Tensor], List[Tensor]]:
747	        """Compute regression, classification and centerss targets for points
748	        in multiple images.
749	
750	        Args:
751	            points (list[Tensor]): Points of each fpn level, each has shape
752	                (num_points, 2).
753	            batch_gt_instances_3d (list[:obj:`InstanceData`]): Batch of
754	                gt_instance_3d.  It usually includes ``bboxes_3d``、
755	                ``labels_3d``、``depths``、``centers_2d`` and attributes.
756	            batch_gt_instances (list[:obj:`InstanceData`]): Batch of
757	                gt_instance.  It usually includes ``bboxes``、``labels``.
758	
759	        Returns:
760	            tuple: Targets of each level.
761	
762	            - concat_lvl_labels_3d (list[Tensor]): 3D Labels of each level.
763	            - concat_lvl_bbox_targets_3d (list[Tensor]): 3D BBox targets of
764	                each level.
765	            - concat_lvl_centerness_targets (list[Tensor]): Centerness targets
766	                of each level.
767	            - concat_lvl_attr_targets (list[Tensor]): Attribute targets of
768	                each level.
769	        """
770	        assert len(points) == len(self.regress_ranges)
771	        num_levels = len(points)
772	        # expand regress ranges to align with points
773	        expanded_regress_ranges = [
774	            points[i].new_tensor(self.regress_ranges[i])[None].expand_as(
775	                points[i]) for i in range(num_levels)
776	        ]
777	        # concat all levels points and regress ranges
778	        concat_regress_ranges = torch.cat(expanded_regress_ranges, dim=0)
779	        concat_points = torch.cat(points, dim=0)
780	
781	        # the number of points per img, per lvl
782	        num_points = [center.size(0) for center in points]
783	
784	        if 'attr_labels' not in batch_gt_instances_3d[0]:
785	            for gt_instances_3d in batch_gt_instances_3d:
786	                gt_instances_3d.attr_labels = \
787	                    gt_instances_3d.labels_3d.new_full(
788	                        gt_instances_3d.labels_3d.shape,
789	                        self.attr_background_label
790	                    )
791	
792	        # get labels and bbox_targets of each image
793	        _, _, labels_3d_list, bbox_targets_3d_list, centerness_targets_list, \
794	            attr_targets_list = multi_apply(
795	                self._get_target_single,
796	                batch_gt_instances_3d,
797	                batch_gt_instances,
798	                points=concat_points,
799	                regress_ranges=concat_regress_ranges,
800	                num_points_per_lvl=num_points)
801	
802	        # split to per img, per level
803	        labels_3d_list = [
804	            labels_3d.split(num_points, 0) for labels_3d in labels_3d_list
805	        ]
806	        bbox_targets_3d_list = [
807	            bbox_targets_3d.split(num_points, 0)
808	            for bbox_targets_3d in bbox_targets_3d_list
809	        ]
810	        centerness_targets_list = [
811	            centerness_targets.split(num_points, 0)
812	            for centerness_targets in centerness_targets_list
813	        ]
814	        attr_targets_list = [
815	            attr_targets.split(num_points, 0)
816	            for attr_targets in attr_targets_list
817	        ]
818	
819	        # concat per level image
820	        concat_lvl_labels_3d = []
821	        concat_lvl_bbox_targets_3d = []
822	        concat_lvl_centerness_targets = []
823	        concat_lvl_attr_targets = []
824	        for i in range(num_levels):
825	            concat_lvl_labels_3d.append(
826	                torch.cat([labels[i] for labels in labels_3d_list]))
827	            concat_lvl_centerness_targets.append(
828	                torch.cat([
829	                    centerness_targets[i]
830	                    for centerness_targets in centerness_targets_list
831	                ]))
832	            bbox_targets_3d = torch.cat([
833	                bbox_targets_3d[i] for bbox_targets_3d in bbox_targets_3d_list
834	            ])
835	            concat_lvl_attr_targets.append(
836	                torch.cat(
837	                    [attr_targets[i] for attr_targets in attr_targets_list]))
838	            if self.norm_on_bbox:
839	                bbox_targets_3d[:, :
840	                                2] = bbox_targets_3d[:, :2] / self.strides[i]
841	            concat_lvl_bbox_targets_3d.append(bbox_targets_3d)
842	        return concat_lvl_labels_3d, concat_lvl_bbox_targets_3d, \
843	            concat_lvl_centerness_targets, concat_lvl_attr_targets

845	    def _get_target_single(
846	            self, gt_instances_3d: InstanceData, gt_instances: InstanceData,
847	            points: Tensor, regress_ranges: Tensor,
848	            num_points_per_lvl: List[int]) -> Tuple[Tensor, ...]:
849	        """Compute regression and classification targets for a single image."""
850	        num_points = points.size(0)
851	        num_gts = len(gt_instances_3d)
852	        gt_bboxes = gt_instances.bboxes
853	        gt_labels = gt_instances.labels
854	        gt_bboxes_3d = gt_instances_3d.bboxes_3d
855	        gt_labels_3d = gt_instances_3d.labels_3d
856	        centers_2d = gt_instances_3d.centers_2d
857	        depths = gt_instances_3d.depths
858	        attr_labels = gt_instances_3d.attr_labels
859	
860	        if not isinstance(gt_bboxes_3d, torch.Tensor):
861	            gt_bboxes_3d = gt_bboxes_3d.tensor.to(gt_bboxes.device)
862	        if num_gts == 0:
863	            return gt_labels.new_full((num_points,), self.background_label), \
864	                   gt_bboxes.new_zeros((num_points, 4)), \
865	                   gt_labels_3d.new_full(
866	                       (num_points,), self.background_label), \
867	                   gt_bboxes_3d.new_zeros((num_points, self.bbox_code_size)), \
868	                   gt_bboxes_3d.new_zeros((num_points,)), \
869	                   attr_labels.new_full(
870	                       (num_points,), self.attr_background_label)
871	
872	        # change orientation to local yaw
873	        gt_bboxes_3d[..., 6] = -torch.atan2(
874	            gt_bboxes_3d[..., 0], gt_bboxes_3d[..., 2]) + gt_bboxes_3d[..., 6]
875	
876	        areas = (gt_bboxes[:, 2] - gt_bboxes[:, 0]) * (
877	            gt_bboxes[:, 3] - gt_bboxes[:, 1])
878	        areas = areas[None].repeat(num_points, 1)
879	        regress_ranges = regress_ranges[:, None, :].expand(
880	            num_points, num_gts, 2)
881	        gt_bboxes = gt_bboxes[None].expand(num_points, num_gts, 4)
882	        centers_2d = centers_2d[None].expand(num_points, num_gts, 2)
883	        gt_bboxes_3d = gt_bboxes_3d[None].expand(num_points, num_gts,
884	                                                 self.bbox_code_size)
885	        depths = depths[None, :, None].expand(num_points, num_gts, 1)
886	        xs, ys = points[:, 0], points[:, 1]
887	        xs = xs[:, None].expand(num_points, num_gts)
888	        ys = ys[:, None].expand(num_points, num_gts)
889	
890	        delta_xs = (xs - centers_2d[..., 0])[..., None]
891	        delta_ys = (ys - centers_2d[..., 1])[..., None]
892	        bbox_targets_3d = torch.cat(
893	            (delta_xs, delta_ys, depths, gt_bboxes_3d[..., 3:]), dim=-1)
894	
895	        left = xs - gt_bboxes[..., 0]
896	        right = gt_bboxes[..., 2] - xs
897	        top = ys - gt_bboxes[..., 1]
898	        bottom = gt_bboxes[..., 3] - ys
899	        bbox_targets = torch.stack((left, top, right, bottom), -1)
900	
901	        assert self.center_sampling is True, 'Setting center_sampling to '\
902	            'False has not been implemented for FCOS3D.'
903	        # condition1: inside a `center bbox`
904	        radius = self.center_sample_radius
905	        center_xs = centers_2d[..., 0]
906	        center_ys = centers_2d[..., 1]
907	        center_gts = torch.zeros_like(gt_bboxes)
908	        stride = center_xs.new_zeros(center_xs.shape)
909	
910	        # project the points on current lvl back to the `original` sizes
911	        lvl_begin = 0
912	        for lvl_idx, num_points_lvl in enumerate(num_points_per_lvl):
913	            lvl_end = lvl_begin + num_points_lvl
914	            stride[lvl_begin:lvl_end] = self.strides[lvl_idx] * radius
915	            lvl_begin = lvl_end
916	
917	        center_gts[..., 0] = center_xs - stride
918	        center_gts[..., 1] = center_ys - stride
919	        center_gts[..., 2] = center_xs + stride
920	        center_gts[..., 3] = center_ys + stride
921	
922	        cb_dist_left = xs - center_gts[..., 0]
923	        cb_dist_right = center_gts[..., 2] - xs
924	        cb_dist_top = ys - center_gts[..., 1]
925	        cb_dist_bottom = center_gts[..., 3] - ys
926	        center_bbox = torch.stack(
927	            (cb_dist_left, cb_dist_top, cb_dist_right, cb_dist_bottom), -1)
928	        inside_gt_bbox_mask = center_bbox.min(-1)[0] > 0
929	
930	        # condition2: limit the regression range for each location
931	        max_regress_distance = bbox_targets.max(-1)[0]
932	        inside_regress_range = (
933	            (max_regress_distance >= regress_ranges[..., 0])
934	            & (max_regress_distance <= regress_ranges[..., 1]))
935	
936	        # center-based criterion to deal with ambiguity
937	        dists = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(bbox_targets_3d[..., :2]**2, dim=-1))
938	        dists[inside_gt_bbox_mask == 0] = INF
939	        dists[inside_regress_range == 0] = INF
940	        min_dist, min_dist_inds = dists.min(dim=1)
941	
942	        labels = gt_labels[min_dist_inds]
943	        labels_3d = gt_labels_3d[min_dist_inds]
944	        attr_labels = attr_labels[min_dist_inds]
945	        labels[min_dist == INF] = self.background_label  # set as BG
946	        labels_3d[min_dist == INF] = self.background_label  # set as BG
947	        attr_labels[min_dist == INF] = self.attr_background_label
948	
949	        bbox_targets = bbox_targets[range(num_points), min_dist_inds]
950	        bbox_targets_3d = bbox_targets_3d[range(num_points), min_dist_inds]
951	        relative_dists = torch.sqrt(
952	            torch.sum(bbox_targets_3d[..., :2]**2,
953	                      dim=-1)) / (1.414 * stride[:, 0])
954	        # [N, 1] / [N, 1]

956
